title: There is a countable unconfined Steiner triple system that is not free
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled proposition at source lines 1097-1098: there exists a countable unconfined Steiner triple system which is not free. The author gave it no label, so its position is part of its identity. The proof (source lines 1099-1102) constructs the witness as the union of a countable elementary chain of unconfined systems, then uses two facts that the statement does not mention: unconfinedness is a property of finite subsets, so it survives the union, while finite generation does not survive, which is what makes the union fail to be free. The statement records only the existence of such a system.
